name: useAnimations
description: Free library of animated icons (24/32 px artboards) for React, with a built-in interaction each. Every icon also has direct SVG and Lottie JSON URLs.

license.name: MIT
license.attribution: Optional, not required. Appreciated example: Animated icons by useAnimations
license.restrictions: None beyond standard MIT terms (provided as-is, without warranty).

web.note: Use the light build unless requiresFullPlayer is true. Use renderer 'svg'; the icons are stroke-based, so CSS `svg path { stroke: ... }` recolors them.

react.usage: import UseAnimations from 'react-useanimations'; import github from 'react-useanimations/lib/github'; <UseAnimations animation={github} size={32} />
react.note: Built-in player (no lottie-web), follows currentColor, respects prefers-reduced-motion. Several icons: import { github, heart } from react-useanimations/icons.

shadcn.usage: npx shadcn@latest add https://useanimations.com/r/<id>.json, then <AnimatedCheckmark size={24} />

interactions.loop: Plays continuously; stays on the static first frame when reduced motion is preferred.
interactions.click-toggle: Toggles between two states on click, or switches immediately when reduced motion is preferred.
interactions.click-replay: Replays once from the start on every click unless reduced motion is preferred.
interactions.hover: Plays forward on mouseenter and backward on mouseleave.
interactions.hover-replay: Plays once on mouseenter unless reduced motion is preferred. Leaving does not stop it; entering during playback does not restart it.
interactions.hover-loop: Loops while hovered, finishes the current cycle after mouseleave and stays static when reduced motion is preferred.

fields.lottie: Lottie JSON URL, CORS-enabled. Use it as `path` in lottie.loadAnimation or download it into the project.
fields.svg: Static SVG(s) of the icon's states (e.g. bell and bell-off).
fields.zip: The same package a human gets from the Download button: <id>.json and the SVGs.
fields.shadcn: shadcn CLI command that adds a ready-made React component (components/animations/<id>.tsx, export Animated<PascalCaseId>).
fields.react: react-useanimations import of the icon (`import`) and its name in react-useanimations/icons (`export`).
fields.snippet: Ready-to-use lottie-web code for the icon's intended interaction, for players outside React; `el` is the container element.
